dashboard.offerYourRoomsToEduloc: Offer your rooms to EduLoc tutors and learners. You do not have to approve every booking: as soon as a tutor accepts a request on a free slot, the room is reserved.
dashboard.n1PresentYourOrganisationAnd: 1. Present your organisation and its supporting documents. 2. Add your rooms: each one is validated separately. 3. Choose a commercial plan, then publish.
dashboard.youHaveNotAddedA: You have not added a room yet.
dashboard.youCanPrepareYourRooms: You can prepare your rooms as drafts. They can only be submitted once the organisation file has been sent.
dashboard.availableOnceTheOrganisationAnd: Available once the organisation and a first room are validated

reservations.noConfirmedSessionsYetThey: No confirmed sessions yet. They will appear here as soon as a tutor accepts a request in one of your rooms.

room.roomValidatedItsNameAddress: Room validated: its name, address, area and minors policy can no longer be changed without a new review.
room.theRoomIsUnderReview: The room is under review; it cannot be edited for now.
room.fillInTheRoomAs: Fill in the room as a draft. It will be reviewed by EduLoc separately from the other rooms of your organisation.
room.neverShownBeforeASession: Never shown before a session is confirmed: only the tutor and the learner concerned receive it, after confirmation.
room.neighbourhoodOrCityOnlyThis: Neighbourhood or city only: this is the only geographic hint visible before confirmation. Do not enter the exact address.
room.thisRoomWasUnpublishedBy: This room was unpublished by EduLoc: it cannot be republished until the review is lifted.
room.publishingRequiresAnActiveCommercial: Publishing requires an active commercial plan for your organisation. Manage the plan →
room.onceClosedTheRoomIs: Once closed, the room is no longer offered and pending requests can no longer be confirmed. Sessions already confirmed are kept.
room.roomSuspendedByEdulocIt: Room suspended by EduLoc: it is no longer bookable.
room.roomRejectedSeeTheMessage: Room rejected. See the message from EduLoc above.
room.theCapacityMustBeAt: The capacity must be at least 1.
room.chooseASearchSuggestionTo: Choose a search suggestion to save the geographic position.
room.sharedOnlyAfterTheSession: Shared only after the session is confirmed.
room.noByDefaultRequestsFor: No by default: requests for a child or teenager will not be offered for this room.
room.unableToChangeTheRoom: Unable to change the room's opening status.
room.completeTheFormSeeThe: Complete the form (see the list above).
room.eachRoomIsReviewedSeparately: Each room is reviewed separately: submitting this one does not commit the others. The organisation must have been submitted.

subscription.thePlanCoversAllThe: The plan covers all the rooms of your organisation. A validated room can only be published while a plan is active; if the plan expires, the rooms are no longer bookable (sessions already confirmed are kept).
subscription.yourRequestIsRegisteredThe: Your request is registered. The plan starts as soon as EduLoc activates it; you will be notified.
subscription.yourRoomsAreNoLonger: Your rooms are no longer bookable. Choose a plan to restore them.
subscription.cancellingThePlanMakesAll: Cancelling the plan makes all your rooms non-bookable. Sessions already confirmed are not cancelled.
subscription.youWillBeAbleTo: You will be able to choose a plan as soon as your organisation and at least one room have been validated by EduLoc.
subscription.noPlanIsOfferedAt: No plan is offered at the moment.
subscription.onlinePaymentIsNotAvailable: Online payment is not available: EduLoc activates the plan after receiving your payment.

venue.withoutANifOrStat: Without a NIF or STAT number, your file stays "pending verification": both are required to obtain the "Verified partner" status. They are never shown publicly.
venue.pdfJpgOrPng10: PDF, JPG or PNG, 10 MB maximum. At least one supporting document is required (for example proof of the right to manage the venue).
venue.unableToDeleteThisSupporting: Unable to delete this supporting document.
venue.thisInformationIsReviewedBy: This information is reviewed by EduLoc before any of your rooms are published.
venue.presentYourOrganisationYouWill: Present your organisation; you will add your rooms afterwards.
venue.yourOrganisationIsValidatedOnly: Your organisation is validated: only the description and contacts can still be edited.
venue.theFileCannotBeEdited: The file cannot be edited in this state.
venue.addAContactPhoneOr: Add a contact phone or email.
venue.addAtLeastOneSupporting: Add at least one supporting document.
